cards.title: Abandoned Bakery
cards.trigger: If the player moves a survivor:
cards.text: The smell of old flour still hangs in the air. Behind the counter, a cabinet door stands half open.

options.label: Option 1
options.text: Search the cabinet. Roll a die. On a 4 or higher, add 2 food to the supply.

cards.title: Town Meeting
cards.trigger: If a survivor the player controls is at the colony:
cards.text: Everyone gathers by the fire to decide how to spend the last of the firewood. Every player with 1 or more survivors at the colony votes with a thumbs up or down.

cards.title: Quiet Night
cards.trigger: If the player controls a survivor at the colony:
cards.text: For once, nothing moves outside the walls.

options.label: Only option
options.text: Each player removes 1 wound from a survivor they control.
